subject.title: Draft: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should OpenClaw publish a separate operator/developer `openclaw commands` inventory and the three advisory plugin descriptor fields while retaining the existing Gateway `commands.list` contract?
rationale: Tests establish behavior, but they cannot decide the permanent public namespace, stable-field commitment, drift ownership, or external plugin compatibility policy while the linked RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve separate audiences
options.body: Keep distinct CLI and Gateway projections, document their ownership boundary, and accept the three plugin fields as advisory public API.

options.title: Canonicalize shared semantics
options.body: Refactor shared command identity and effect metadata behind one canonical model before publishing audience-specific projections.

options.title: Wait for RFC direction
options.body: Keep the draft open without merge preparation until the linked RFC and required maintainer discussion settle the public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve separate audiences
recommendation.body: Keep distinct CLI and Gateway projections, document their ownership boundary, and accept the three plugin fields as advisory public API.

likelyOwner.reason: The broadest recent history and live discussion routing across the affected CLI, plugin, and Gateway surfaces points here for the product-contract choice.
